tools.name: rockgympro_list_facilities
tools.description: List the facilities the connected API key can read, with their 3-letter codes. Start here to find a facilityCode for the other tools. Rock Gym Pro API: GET /v1/facilities.

tools.name: rockgympro_get_connection_info
tools.description: Show the token information for the connected API key. Use it to check that the key works. Rock Gym Pro API: GET /v1/me.

tools.name: rockgympro_get_setting
tools.description: Get one setting value by name (the settings table), optionally for several facilities. Rock Gym Pro API: GET /v1/settings.

tools.name: rockgympro_list_customers
tools.description: List the customers of a facility, filtered by type, status, dates, name, email or address. Text filters accept % wildcards. Page through results with page and limit. Rock Gym Pro API: GET /v1/customers/facility/{facilityCode}.

tools.name: rockgympro_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer's details by customer GUID. Rock Gym Pro API: GET /v1/customers/{customerGuid}.

tools.name: rockgympro_list_bookings
tools.description: List the bookings of a facility, optionally for one customer or a date-time range. Page with startId, page and limit. Rock Gym Pro API: GET /v1/bookings/facility/{facilityCode}.

tools.name: rockgympro_get_booking
tools.description: Get one booking's details by its ID. Rock Gym Pro API: GET /v1/bookings/facility/{facilityCode}/{bookingId}.

tools.name: rockgympro_list_checkins
tools.description: List the check-ins of a facility, optionally for one customer or a date-time range. Page with startId, page and limit. Rock Gym Pro API: GET /v1/checkins/facility/{facilityCode}.

tools.name: rockgympro_get_checkin
tools.description: Get one check-in by its ID. Rock Gym Pro API: GET /v1/checkins/facility/{facilityCode}/{checkinId}.

tools.name: rockgympro_get_active_checkin_count
tools.description: Get how many customers are checked in right now at a facility. Rock Gym Pro API: GET /v1/checkins/active/facility/{facilityCode}.

tools.name: rockgympro_list_invoices
tools.description: List the invoices of a facility, optionally for one customer or a date-time range. Void invoices are included unless includeVoidInvoices is 0. Rock Gym Pro API: GET /v1/invoices/facility/{facilityCode}.

tools.name: rockgympro_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice's details by its ID. Rock Gym Pro API: GET /v1/invoices/facility/{facilityCode}/{invoiceId}.

tools.name: rockgympro_list_sales
tools.description: List sales by product for a facility, optionally for one product or a date-time range. Rock Gym Pro API: GET /v1/sales/facility/{facilityCode}.

tools.name: rockgympro_list_timeclock_entries
tools.description: List staff timeclock entries of a facility, optionally for one customer (staff member) or a date-time range. Rock Gym Pro API: GET /v1/timeclocks/facility/{facilityCode}.

tools.name: rockgympro_get_timeclock_entry
tools.description: Get one timeclock entry by its ID. Rock Gym Pro API: GET /v1/timeclocks/facility/{facilityCode}/{timeclockId}.

tools.name: rockgympro_list_daily_numbers
tools.description: List the daily number figures of a facility for a date range, optionally for one tag. Rock Gym Pro API: GET /v1/dailynumbers/facility/{facilityCode}.

tools.name: rockgympro_list_staff
tools.description: List the staff records the connected API key can read. Rock Gym Pro API: GET /v1/staff.

tools.name: rockgympro_list_event_widgets
tools.description: List the event widget GUIDs of a facility. Use a GUID with rockgympro_get_event_widget_events. Rock Gym Pro API: GET /v1/widgets/events/facility/{facilityCode}.

tools.name: rockgympro_get_event_widget_events
tools.description: Get the events of one event widget for a facility and a date-time range. Rock Gym Pro API: GET /v1/widgets/events/facility/{facilityCode}/{eventWidgetGuid}.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: rockgympro_list_customers · Private data: rockgympro_list_facilities, rockgympro_get_connection_info, rockgympro_list_staff · Public sink: rockgympro_list_customers.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: rockgympro_list_customers · Private data: rockgympro_list_facilities, rockgympro_get_connection_info, rockgympro_list_staff · Public sink: rockgympro_list_customers

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
